_about: Hand-checked dice effects for talents whose text the importer cannot read on its own, or reads wrongly. Each talent maps to a list of effects: t = b (add Boost), k (ignore Setback), up (upgrade the pool), dn (downgrade the difficulty), df (one fewer Difficulty die); n = how many; r = 1 if that is per rank; sk = skill names ('*' any skill, 'combat', 'Knowledge', 'Piloting', 'Ranged' are groups); c = the condition — present means it is a tick box on the Dice tab, absent means it always applies. An empty list switches a talent's automatic reading off.

Quick Strike.c: the target has not acted yet this encounter

True Aim.c: True Aim maneuver, once per round (counts as aiming)
True Aim maneuver, once per round

Precise Aim.c: Precise Aim maneuver: suffer that much strain to ignore the target's defense

Brace.c: Brace maneuver first; environmental Setback only

Codebreaker.c: breaking a code or decrypting communications
breaking a code or decrypting communications

Bypass Security.c: disabling a security device or opening a locked door

Respected Scholar.c: dealing with an institute of learning
